posts.text:
Pluto Security leaves stealth with $42 million to watch AI agents

Pluto Security says about 60% of the AI risks it detects come from vibe-coded tools built by non-developers, with finance staff the biggest source, TechCrunch reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-pluto-security-42m/

DeepMind details Singapore's on-device Gemma scam filter in two stages

Google DeepMind says a two-stage Gemma pipeline for Singapore scans private chats for scams on the phone, with no conversation data sent to the cloud.

https://theaipost.net/story/cb026977f/

Nvidia says RTX Spark laptops ship Friday with a 74B open model

Nvidia says its Nemotron 3.5 Bolt, a 74-billion-parameter open model with training data and recipes, runs in 24GB through 2-bit quantisation on RTX Spark laptops that launch on 16 October.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-nvidia-rtx-spark-nemotron-bolt/

Nvidia opens up the code for its Run AI GPU scheduler

Nvidia says the full Run:ai platform, which schedules and splits GPUs on Kubernetes, is now open source on GitHub, with no paid subscription needed but no Nvidia support either.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-nvidia-runai-open-source/

Pulse Local is a Mac budgeting app with its AI models on-device

The free Apple Silicon beta downloads about 2.9 GB of small open models and, its maker says, keeps the ledger and chat questions on the machine.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-pulse-local/
